title: Light weight, handy washing machine shelf
text: Light weight, handy washing machine shelf. This shelf is handy if you don't have cabinets abover your washer.  It's not super sturdy, but it does the job.  It looks nice and fits well behind the washing machine.

product_metadata.title: Mind Reader Metal Long Washing Machine Shelf and Rack with 4 Hooks, White
features: 1 laundry basket to put all your dirty Clothes in for convenience
An open spot to put your washing machine

description: Need more space for your laundry detergents and cleaning supplies? keep everything about your washer machine instead of in the basement pantries or cabinets. It's everything in one that even has a spot for your washer machine! don't forget the spot to put your dirty clothes in, this way you can have your clothes washed in an instant. Stop walking up and down stairs or back and forth for things.
